en.headline: Blue Lock anime exhibition runs at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak until 24 November
en.dek: The official animation exhibition’s first overseas stop features life-size displays, a recreated Z-team locker room and a Hong Kong-exclusive pop-up store.
body: The Blue Lock EGOIST EXHIBITION the animation continues at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak through 24 November as the official anime exhibition’s first stop outside Japan.

Organisers said the show occupies spaces across several floors, including a large immersive area on level 1 and special displays plus a Hong Kong-exclusive pop-up store on level 4. Highlights include a one-to-one recreation of the Z-team locker room with character-specific items and life-size character figures.
The exhibition runs daily from 11:00 to 21:00, with last entry at 20:00. Ticket prices start at HK$98 for a single adult, with pair and family options available, according to the ticketing platform.
AIRSIDE listed the event among its current offerings, confirming the venue at 2 Concorde Road, Kai Tak, and the multi-level layout near designated shops on the ground, first and fourth floors.

zh.headline: 藍色監獄動畫展於啟德AIRSIDE舉行至11月24日
zh.dek: 官方動畫展海外首站設等身展示、1:1還原Z隊更衣室及香港限定快閃店。
body: 《藍色監獄展 EGOIST EXHIBITION the animation》於啟德AIRSIDE繼續舉行，至11月24日，為官方動畫展的海外首站。
主辦單位表示展覽橫跨多層，包括一樓大型沉浸式展區及四樓特別展覽與香港限定快閃店。亮點包括1:1還原Z隊更衣室，內有角色專屬物品，以及等身角色立像。
展覽每日上午11時至晚上9時開放，最後入場時間為晚上8時。票價成人單人票由98港元起，另有雙人及家庭票選擇，售票平台顯示。
AIRSIDE網站將活動列為現正舉行項目，確認地點為啟德協調道2號，展區位於指定商舖附近的地下、一樓及四樓。
